llm.summary: This is a disclosed routing and onboarding skill for the AI KEY skill family, with no evidence of hidden execution, exfiltration, or destructive behavior.

dimensions.detail: The included script only reads installed skill directories under common skill locations and prints names/descriptions/paths for routing; it does not modify files or access unrelated data.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Upgrade examples use unpinned npx commands and global skill install/remove flows; these are disclosed user-run instructions, not automatic runtime behavior, but users should verify the package/source before running them.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger phrases are broad and could activate for ordinary requests like making a short video or asking how to use something, but that matches the stated entrypoint purpose and is openly declared.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Family guidance references vault configuration, skill memory, and output files for downstream skills; this is disclosed and purpose-aligned for a reusable content/business workflow, while the entry skill itself mainly routes and prompts.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifact coherently acts as a public entrypoint that routes users to content or business skills, generates handoff prompts, and provides onboarding/navigation guidance.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you want a Chinese-first AI KEY router that can guide content and business workflows. Review the unpinned npx upgrade commands before running them, and be aware that downstream AI KEY skills may read configured vault/memory paths or write drafts/memory as part of their documented workflows.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: Broad activation language is real, but it is consistent with a top-level router intended for users who do not know which AI KEY skill to call.
[AE1] expected: The scanner reported incomplete inspection of referenced material; manual inspection covered the required SKILL.md, the script, and relevant references, and found no hidden payload.
[RP1] expected: Unpinned npx install/remove examples create normal supply-chain caution for user-run upgrade commands, but the artifact does not execute them automatically.
[SDI-1] expected: The direct-entry exception applies when the user explicitly names a downstream skill, so it is disclosed user-directed routing rather than hidden scope expansion.
[SDI-4] expected: The onboarding no-write promise applies to the compressed demo; choosing to continue into full routing may run the read-only discovery script, which is disclosed and non-mutating.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese wording constraints and script output are locale/style choices for this Chinese-language skill family, not security-relevant hidden control.
